name: Sheraton Grand Danang Beach Resort & Spa
positioning: A beachfront resort in Danang with balconied rooms facing the pool or coastline, plunge-pool rooms, suites with kitchenettes, round-the-clock access to Da Nang's longest swimming pool, and a Kids' Club and mini water park for families
best_for: Beach travelers who want a balcony with pool, bay or sea views
Couples and honeymooners who want a room with a private plunge pool
Families who want suites with kitchenettes plus a Kids' Club and mini water park

facts.text: Rooms have private balconies with views of the pool or the Danang coastline.
Deluxe Rooms have a balcony with a partial sea view, pool view or bay view.
Suites have a living room and dining area, a sofa, a kitchenette and a large private balcony.
Suite bathrooms have marble accents, full vanities and luxury bathrobes.
Larger suites with extra space and a kitchenette suit family vacations or honeymoons.
The Deluxe Plunge Pool room's plunge pool is on a private patio.
The Deluxe Suite has a separate living room.
Deluxe Suites come with a pool, bay or sea view.
Suites have a full-size fridge and a titanium Nespresso Pixie machine.
Families have a dedicated Kids' Club, an outdoor playground and a mini water park.
Room service is available 24 hours a day.

highlights.text: The resort offers beachfront accommodations in Danang.
Guests have 24/7 access to Da Nang's longest swimming pool and a modern fitness center.
The Deluxe Plunge Pool room has its own private plunge pool.
Rooms have private balconies with views of the pool or the Danang coastline.
Families have a dedicated Kids' Club, an outdoor playground and a mini water park.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the resort is outside the Da Nang city center, so exploring the city requires transportation.
WhataHotel notes the large-scale resort atmosphere may feel less intimate for travelers seeking a boutique experience.
